findings.problem: Notion DelegationAdapter is Awaitable[str] and dispatcher rejects empty text; Qwen coding subagent returns structured ok/uncertain/skipped/resumed/code/text states. The current neutral envelope cannot losslessly carry Qwen completion safety state.

findings.candidate_invariant: A failure after a mutating tool may have committed must not be represented as ordinary retryable tool error unless the executor can prove no side effect occurred. Surface/persist UNCERTAIN or require idempotency/reconciliation before another mutation.
findings.cross_project_comparison: Qwen already tracks possible mutating tools and marks later failures uncertain via markUncertainAfterPotentialSideEffect, blocking automatic persisted retry.
findings.problem: DelegatedToolLoopSession catches any Exception from tool_executor and turns it into ordinary tool_execution_failed. If a mutating tool committed its side effect and then failed during acknowledgement/serialization/transport boundary, the model sees a retryable failure and may repeat the mutation with a new call_id.
